name: Discord Activity
description: Shows live agent and tool activity as a Discord message that is updated and deleted when the agent finishes.

maxToolHistoryLength.description: Maximum number of tool calls to keep in history

maxStatusMessageLength.description: Maximum length of Discord status message content, capped at 1700 characters

orphanTtlSeconds.description: Time in seconds before orphaned tool calls are pruned

maxDisplaySeconds.description: Maximum idle time in seconds after status activity before automatic cleanup

replyMode.description: Whether status messages reply to all source messages when available or only in canonical private-message sessions; channel and group statuses remain standalone

skillLearnedNotice.description: Summary settings for the rewritten background skill-review notice

model.description: Model ref (provider/model) used to summarize learned-skill changes; omit to use the default agent model. Requires plugins.entries.discord-activity.llm.allowModelOverride

promptAppend.description: Extra instructions appended to the summary system prompt, for example the language or tone of the summary
